note: Deterministic authored malformed-WGSL corpus. Every case must be rejected by naga::front::wgsl or Validator(all, WebGPU-baseline capabilities).

cases.description: Function body ends before its closing brace.
Global variable declares an unknown WGSL address space.
A vec3 value is returned from a vec4 function.
A binary expression combines vectors of incompatible widths.
A runtime-sized array is placed in uniform address space.
A compute entry point writes through a read-only storage binding.
Two resources used by one entry point collide at group 0 binding 0.
A bound resource specifies binding without group.
A compute entry point omits its mandatory workgroup_size attribute.
A vertex entry point returns only a user location and no position builtin.
A compute workgroup dimension is zero.
A sampler handle is illegally declared in uniform address space.
A write-only storage texture is read with textureLoad.
An explicitly suffixed u32 literal exceeds the u32 range.
A decimal f32 literal overflows to infinity.
A u32 value is shifted by its full bit width.
A constant integer expression divides by zero.
